notes.title: CTFDL Season 4 Sign Ups
notes.content:
CTFDL Season 4 Registration is NOW OPEN!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/1eea31f53668c90dacd5430f10b01d3f6193650e.png
Registration for Capture the Flag Draft League (CTFDL) Season 4 is officially underway! Visit https://ctfpl.net/ctfdl-sign-up-form/ to secure your spot.

Important Updates for Season 4

Teams will now start with THREE players: a captain and two co-captains.
At least ONE of the three leadership players MUST be a USL participant. This ensures active USL player involvement in team leadership!
Exclusive USL Draft Rounds: While USL players can be drafted at any time, Rounds 4, 8, and 12 will be exclusively dedicated to selecting from the USL player pool.


Key Dates to Remember

Registration Deadline: Thursday, May 8 at 11:59pm ET
CTFDL S4 Draft: Saturday, May 10
Opening Day Matches: Sunday, May 18


Why Participate?

Be part of an incredibly active, welcoming community.
Enjoy balanced, exciting gameplay on the improved Twin Peaks map.
Experience enhanced content with Live Commentary, Podcasts, and Match VODs.
Compete alongside veterans and newcomers in a thriving competitive atmosphere.


Get More Involved
We are actively looking for help with audio/video editing, graphic design, live commentary, match reports, refereeing, and more! Let us know how you want to get involved—we want you!

Help Us Spread the Word!
We need your help sharing the excitement and recruiting players old and new! Spread the message, invite your friends, and let's make Season 4 the biggest and best yet!

Don't miss out on the most exciting CTFDL season yet!

Sign Up and Get Involved Now

Register Here
Discord
Facebook


Get ready—CTFDL Season 4 is going to be EPIC!

notes.title: CTFDL Season 3 Sign Ups, CTF OVDL Playoffs, and Zone Updates
notes.content:
CTFDL3 Sign Ups
The deadline for sign up is Saturday, February 1, 2025 at 11:59 PM PST.

Spread the word! Contact your friends, former players, and current competitors—let’s make this the best season yet!

Sign Up

Capture the Flag Offense vs Defense League Playoffs
The regular season has now concluded. Here are the final standings heading into the playoffs: 

#1 Des & Friends 4-0
#2 AntiEgo 2-2
#3 Above Average At Aiming 2-2
#4 OnlyFrags 1-3
#5 Veni Vidi Vici - 1-3 

PLAYOFF SCHEDULE
PLAY-IN
Veni Vidi Vici (#5) @ OnlyFrags (#4) - Match Time TBD

SEMI-FINALS
Above Average At Aiming (#3) @ AntiEgo (#2) - MATCH CONFIRMED for Tuesday 1/21 @ 10:30 PM EST 
Winner of Play-In game @ Des & Friends - TBD

OVDL Finals (Best of Five)
TBD

Zone Updates
CTF - Twin Peaks 2.0
Zone renamed from Twin Peaks 2016 to Twin Peaks 2.0

Tons of updates have been made since October.  Take a look at the Zone News when you log in for a full list of changes.  A few highlights:

Perm desync bug fixed.
Map Updates: Large housekeeping update to improve map readability/organization, balance some discrepancies between Collective/Titan, and revamp unused bases on the map.  Should address many of the major pain points on the map as we return to more regular league play.
MiniTP event is the default mode for Arena 1, this can be turned off with *event None by a mod
Turret stats added to breakdown and properly resets per game.
saveState (name) and loadState (name) saves the state of health, energy, direction, and inventory counts for all players in game. This will allow practicing equal, advantaged, or disadvantaged states with repetition/consistency.


Mod Commands:

*arenaprofile command checks for minerals/premades and displays counts if any detected. If none detected, no message displayed.
*overtime / *ot reduces heal/repair 50%.  15 minutes after OT is triggered, OT2 will automatically trigger which further reduces heal/repair.  The ot command has a parameter for time.
IE: *ot 30 will trigger overtime when the current game's time reaches 30 minutes, giving a large room for error.  


Questions or feedback? Reach out on Discord

notes.title: September Zone Updates
notes.content:
Zone Updates
CTF - Twin Peaks 2016
CTFDL Season 1 was a success and changes have been made to the zone in preparation for Season 2.  Please share your feedback on these changes at the CTFPL Discord.


Gameplay & Balance Changes

Asynchronous reload (No load jam) for AutoGun kits, Stim Pack, Energizer, Repulsor Field, Repulsor Charge
PowerCells, Vehicles, Mines can now be sold.
DropShip items disappear when dropped EXCEPT FOR Minerals, AutoGuns, Steron Injection
Medics can now use EMP Mines
New Engineer AutoGuns (Skip kit building phase) listed under [NEW ITEMS]
Legacy AutoGun Kits changes (to bring in line with Turret Box strength):

Removed weights 
Changed to asynchronous reload (removes load jam)

Turret Box turret order is now consistently Plasma > MG > Rocket
Moved to [NEW ITEMS] FPack and HBoard (blue item versions of vehicles)
Pandora's Element easier to pickup for engineer (Spacebar Inputs: 2 > 1)
[Item Bundles] category in the store
Adjusted infil class announcement (color, text)

Command Changes

?wipe (?w) 			    ---- wipes inventory
?build (?b)   ---- purchases list of items for a build; buildName list: dinf, dinfcaw, oinf, oinfcara, eng, jt, infil, dhvyAxi, ohvyAxi, ohvyAxi2, slBR, slbonds, medbonds
?build (?b) 	    ---- selects a random build for your class
?bw 				    ---- wipes inventory, purchases build {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/44088d8a59ac9b212b659f63cbd625b009d911a2.png
?bwd 				    ---- wipes inventory, purchases build, purchases preselected drop list
?d 				    ---- Drop excess ammo (autocalculated); Items dropped:

ammo rifle, 400
ammo pistol, 500
ammo shotgun, 200
ammo mg, 250 
rocket, 40 
Heavy HE, 20 
Light HE, 50 
Fuel Canister, 120 
AP Mine, 5 
Plasma Mine, 5 
tranq, 10 
sentry, 1

?short 		    ---- generates buy macro for current inventory
?short          ---- gives the shorthand name of an item; Examples:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/b8c1af38275594bedc871b0ee8805c08161cbde8.png
?short pf generator ---- "pf" 
?short CMP6  Assault Armor ---- "p6"
?buy pf,p6 

?swap 				 ---- Swap class (IE: ?swap inf, ?swap sl, etc.); Swap list: 	INF, INFIL, HVY, JT, SL, MED, ENG

Moderation Changes

*sdHeal - New sudden death command

Deluxe Medikit/Medikit healing halved when triggered 
Restored to normal during 10 man

*mix - automated mix setup, keeps track of who didn't play last, automatically unspecs teams based on required roles/team comps for offense/defense
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/40a1cdf5ad084ab5352bed054e47020fe438c2ca.png

Use ?mix role1,role2 to signup
Example: ?mix oinf, dinf (oinf is 1st preference, dinf is 2nd)
All possible values: 

dinf
oinf
dhvy
ohvy
sl
med
eng
infil
jt

notes.title: CTF Draft League and Zone Updates
notes.content:
Capture the Flag Draft League 2024-1 Announced!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/d89dbf4cdede0e8dfcc48d5595bf1f92e1f022d4.jpg
Register
Tentative CTFDL Important Dates:

 Registration will close Sunday August 11th at 11:59pm ET.
 Sunday August 18, 10:00pm ET, live CTFDL Draft w/ commentary
 Sunday August 25, first round of matches
 Sunday September 1, second round of matches
 Sunday September 8, third round of matches (if needed, pending on # of teams and playoffs structure)

CTFDL Rules (subject to change):

All participants must register (registration link below).
Number of Teams and Captains, schedules, brackets, and playoff structures will be decided once registrations and number of participants is confirmed.
Discord (CTF Server) will be required (excluding the use of mics) to participate.
Once you are registered, you can be selected by any captain at any point in the draft. If you refuse to participate on a team, you were picked on, or you intentionally throw/troll, or your refuse to cooperate with your team or team captain, you will be ineligible from participating in future CTFDLs. Additionally, if you register for CTFDL, you are expected to exhibit due diligence with your participation, attendance, effort, teamwork, and communication.
ALL players that register will be picked to a team. Picking will continue until all registered players have been selected. Therefore, many new players, new CTF players, or new to organized play players will be spread out across all teams. It does not benefit new players to auto-bench them or refuse to allow them the opportunity to play/contribute. Additionally, it DOES help new players when seasoned players work with them, help them, teach them, and mentor them.
If you are a newer player, or, not accustomed to CTFPL or organized CTF play, it is expected that you are a good team player, willing to learn, open to feedback, and willing to communicate with your team.
Team Captains are expected to: Be active, be fair, have a firm understanding of organized 10v10 CTF matches, lead their team, have a firm understanding of team composition and player abilities, be able to draft a competitive team, treat all players with respect.
Team Captains must appoint two co-captains after their team is drafted and notify CTFDL staff. Co-captains will be held to the same standard as Team Captains. 
Substitute players (or “NTs”) are allowed. No more than 2 NTs can be used by a team per match. NT player selections will be drafted snake style (ex: 1-2-1 if both teams are using 2 NTs). “Home” team or higher seeded team gets first NT pick. A NT player cannot be on another CTFDL team. If an NT player refuses to play on a team, they will be ineligible to NT for the remainder of the -CTFDL season. A player may not NT for more than one team per week. NT players may only be used if there are not enough team players online and available (ie: you cannot use an NT player to replace a lesser experienced player on your team).
CTFDL matches will start with a maximum of 150 tox, 150 tso, and 50 pandora’s element. 
CTFDL matches must start within 15 minutes of their scheduled time. 
CTFDL matches will be scheduled on Sundays between the hours of 8:00pm ET and 11:00pm ET. CTFDL staff will work with CTFDL captains to assist with scheduling.
CTFDL matches must be scheduled at least 60 minutes apart, to maximize attendance and opportunities to spectate. 
Additional rules/procedures will be added.

Questions? Contact Zmn in-game or on Discord
CTFDL 2024-1 registration will close Sunday August 11th at 11:59pm ET.
Register

Zone Updates
All Zones

Jackpots are back!  When you win, you will now get points, cash, and experience based on your contribution.  This should help those of you trying to achieve that coveted Storm Lord rank.

 *sd now has custom sound effect and arena message to make it more visible and obvious that sudden death has been triggered
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/86c33cf05972e133b53e32d851b6e1e99c7e39f9.png

 Fixed bug where you could travel to the mini map while on a vehicle if you were on Titan Militia.

League News!

USL season 23 continues as we reach the end of the regular season, there's one more weekend of matches before we head into the playoffs. If you're interested in participating in the Unified Skirmish League or want to learn more information you can join the official USL Discord or visit the Uslzone website.

PayPigs over kNock Your Punkass Down 128-33 (MVP: THE MOUNTAIN)

The week 8 preview is now live!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bZJqWm4DDI0

Zone Updates!

CTF - Twin Peaks 2016
We have made a ton of updates to the zone since the Steam release.  We’re always looking for player feedback on the CTFPL Discord.

Stats are back!

 Stats for MVP Score, Games Won, Games Lost, Carry Time, Carry Time+, Captures, Carry Kills, and Carrier Kills are now tracked.
 Top 100 charts for Yearly, Monthly, Weekly, and Daily are now tracked and populated.
 Score History charts for Yearly, Monthly, Weekly, and Daily are now tracked and populated
 Player Profile and Lag Charts now show Squad and Team names


Gameplay Changes


 Default class set to Infantry for new players
 Team scramble has been added after each game
 Haywire grenades now affect turrets
 Flags changed to touch to capture to mirror legacy public settings
 5th flag was added to bridge


Moderation Changes


 *setup now spawns flag in the desired base for OvD
 *sd command created to support sudden death in organized mixes.  Command will reset all flags and move them to a random bridge.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed random flag drop near A5 base
 Fixed hidden physics at E4
 Fixed default map team names
 Fixed players not getting healed at the start of a new game
 Fixed Dueler class being enabled during public play
 Fixed Turret Kit weights
 Steron Injections can no longer be repeatedly dropped to reset the timer
 Victory timer now correctly says 90 seconds
 Collective Military team name renamed to ‘Collective’ so the text does not clip team size
